copy.tagline: 集成支付宝支付，支持签名安全与网关对齐
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为网站或App接入支付宝支付功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Alipay payments with signed request safety and gateway alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are integrating Alipay into your web or mobile app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你设计并实现支付宝支付集成，包括选择集成方式、处理签名验证和金额校验，管理测试到上线的流程，并记录所有配置和日志到本地文件夹。
howto.when: 当你要为网站或 App 添加支付宝支付功能（结账、订阅、跨境钱包）时触发。

say.text: 帮我为移动端结账集成支付宝，使用网关重定向方式。
say.note: Claude 会生成集成方案和代码。

say.text: 验证支付宝回调签名后更新订单状态。
say.note: Claude 会强调签名校验步骤。

say.text: 配置支付宝沙箱环境并测试退款流程。

howto.what_en: Claude helps design and implement Alipay payment integration: selects integration path (web redirect, app SDK, PSP), handles signing, amount validation, callback verification, and manages test-to-production rollout. Local notes store state and decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user needs Alipay for checkout, subscriptions, or cross-border wallet flows. Agent handles architecture, signing, gateway integration, rollout validation, and post-launch operations.

say_en.text: Integrate Alipay for mobile checkout using gateway redirect.
say_en.note: Claude produces integration plan and code.

say_en.text: Verify Alipay callback signature then update order status.
Configure Alipay sandbox and test refund flow.
